scientific_integrity: New claim is the infinite-family split integral summand, plus the rational degree-four representation for seven labels; the previously established mod-two rank is not claimed as new. The proof does not determine any extra homology or torsion and does not use finite experiments to justify its universal assertion.
scientific_limitations: Only an underlying abelian-group splitting is proved; no integral group-equivariant splitting.
For n > 7 completeness of the summand is unknown.
At n = 7 odd-primary torsion and other integral homology degrees are not determined.
The sufficient threshold n >= 7 is not claimed optimal.
Unindexed or differently formulated prior results remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Star-sphere retractions and signed permutation homology of triangular-graph neighborhood complexes
